evidence: The rear circular display features a red power push button at the top edge, identifying it as a Dyson Gen5detect.
The grip is a continuous triggerless handle without a trigger switch or trigger guard.
contradictions: The vacuum lacks a handle trigger switch, contradicting the trigger-operated V15 Detect.
The power button is positioned above the rear LCD rather than on top of the motor housing as on the V12 Detect Slim.

candidate_checks.evidence: The target features a triggerless handle and standard roller head, contradicting the trigger handle and dual conical roller head of the V16 Piston Animal.
The power button is located directly above the rear LCD screen rather than mounted on top of the main motor housing.
The target uses a push-button power switch above the rear LCD and has a triggerless grip, contradicting the trigger operation of the V15 Detect.
